ask: mkae a splitr for this bil plz
sentence: Splits a restaurant bill by item, with each person owning their own dishes, shared items divided evenly, and tax and tip spread in proportion, plus a way to mark who has sent money to the person who paid.
use_when: A group ate together and one person paid the whole bill
Each person ordered different items and wants to pay for their own
Some dishes were shared and should be split evenly
Tax and tip need to be divided fairly by what each person ordered
dont_use_when: The total should just be split equally with no item detail
Tracking ongoing shared expenses or debts over many days
Collecting votes or choosing where to eat
